# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta has a remarkably wide grin and cheerful demeanor. She wears very blue bows on her head.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted, faithful, and cheerful handmaiden who is deeply devoted to her mistress. She is extraordinarily obedient and will happily follow instructions even if they sound absurd. Although she is somewhat accident-prone and lacks patience with men, she wholeheartedly admires Anne Shirley and enjoys replicating her mannerisms.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)_

## Goals

- To move to Boston when she turns sixteen  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

## History

Charlotta came to live at Echo Lodge to serve Miss Lavendar Lewis for board and clothes, following in the footsteps of her elder sisters Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina. Because Miss Lavendar calls all the Bowman sisters "Charlotta" to avoid confusion, she became "Charlotta the Fourth." She welcomed Anne Shirley and Diana Barry warmly during their visits to Echo Lodge, bonding with them and practicing in front of a mirror to copy Anne's graceful movements and chin uplift. When Miss Lavendar became quiet and withdrawn, Charlotta grew deeply concerned for her well-being, especially when Miss Lavendar failed to scold her after she accidentally broke an heirloom bowl. She later assisted Anne in sewing a new organdy dress for Miss Lavendar and helped prepare Echo Lodge for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c30 P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the fourth sister in her family to work for Miss Lavendar for board and clothes  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Is the last and best of the Bowman girls  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> “Yes, ma’am, so do I. That’s just exactly how I feel too, ma’am,”  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>

> “Miss Lavendar isn’t well, Miss Shirley, ma’am. I’m sure she isn’t, though she never complains.”  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

> “Please, Miss Shirley, ma’am, it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums.”  <sub>[v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

> “I hope that he’ll marry Miss Lavendar. Some women’s intended from the start to be old maids, and I’m afraid I’m one of them, Miss Shirley, ma’am, because I’ve awful little patience with the men.”  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
